race.comment: ANEMACORE (1) hasn't won for a while but is teasing punters with a string of whirlwind finishes. Did it again last start when he came from last on the bend to be beaten under a length in a similar race to this. Draws in close for the first time in five runs so may settle a touch closer. Deserves a win. PEREILLE (4) has not appeared since coming from the clouds to grab second in the Listed Ramornie over 1200m at Grafton 24 days ago. Not as effective over this distance but his class will take him a long way. EXPRESS PAYMENT (11) led last start and held on gamely for second over the mile at Doomben. Goes well here at this trip and with the light weight looks sure to run his usual honest race. EDITED BY (10) turned things around with a gallant third over this course and distance recently. Can take another step forward at just the fourth run of the campaign. WARBY (7) hasn't won in ages but is a classy type right down in the weights. Do not underestimate.
